reasoning_summary: Use a horizontal +y side grasp at the crucible's measured mid-height, lift 0.10 m, then raise further for transport around the robot's inner workspace and above the dosing balance. Follow the requested front and insertion TCP coordinates exactly. The supplied crucible AABB is 0.075 m high: with a centre grasp, TCP z=1.066 puts its bottom at 1.0285, which is 0.0725 m above the cavity floor rather than the stated 0.05 m. Prioritize the explicit TCP coordinates, then lower to TCP z=0.9935 for floor contact. Chamber entry and intentional floor contact are exceptions to exterior-obstacle clearance.

waypoints.name: clear_pick_area
waypoints.clearance_note: Move away from nearby bottles before the side approach; validate the orientation transition against the full gripper geometry.

waypoints.name: side_pregrasp
waypoints.clearance_note: Approach position is 0.12 m along -y from the crucible centre. The approach route passes to the +x side of the pipette.

waypoints.name: side_grasp
waypoints.clearance_note: Translate along +y to the centre at 50% height; fingers close across x. Contact with the grasp target is intentional.

waypoints.name: lift_010
waypoints.clearance_note: Lift exactly 0.10 m without rotating the crucible.

waypoints.name: raise_for_transport
waypoints.clearance_note: Crucible bottom reaches 1.2625 m, exceeding the dosing-balance top by 0.1225 m.

waypoints.name: route_south_of_base
waypoints.clearance_note: Maintain y=-0.2 to avoid crossing the robot's inner usable-radius boundary.

waypoints.name: clear_balance_and_paper
waypoints.clearance_note: Maintain transport height over the balance region; finish east of the weighing paper before descending.

waypoints.name: oven_front
waypoints.clearance_note: Reach the exact requested front position, outside the oven and clear of other station AABBs.

waypoints.name: straight_door_insertion
waypoints.clearance_note: Translate only along +y. TCP penetration is 0.080 m, below the 0.15 m limit; the crucible fits inside the cavity.

waypoints.name: place_on_cavity_floor
waypoints.clearance_note: Lower 0.0725 m so the crucible bottom reaches z=0.956; release only after supported floor contact.

waypoints.name: straight_door_retreat
waypoints.clearance_note: Withdraw along -y without lateral motion or rotation, leaving the crucible on the floor.

waypoints.name: rise_after_retreat
waypoints.clearance_note: Rise exactly 0.15 m after clearing the opening.

safety_checks: All listed TCP targets lie within the 0.32–0.75 m usable radius using either horizontal distance or full distance from the supplied base position.
Interpolate translational segments with increments no greater than 0.020 m; enforce orientation deviation no greater than 0.25 rad.
Maintain the horizontal +y grasp orientation after attachment, without tilting the crucible.
Maintain at least 0.03 m TCP and carried-object clearance from non-target AABBs; intentional grasp contact, chamber passage, and floor support are excluded.
At insertion, the crucible AABB is [2.214, 0.577, 1.0285] to [2.286, 0.649, 1.1035], within the specified cavity.
At release, the crucible AABB is [2.214, 0.577, 0.956] to [2.286, 0.649, 1.031], with its bottom on the cavity floor.
Confirm sufficient gripper opening for the 0.072 m grasp width and verify finger clearance above the cavity floor during release and withdrawal.
Before execution, validate full-arm inverse kinematics, swept gripper geometry, initial orientation transition, and the open-door geometry; TCP/AABB checks alone do not certify these.
